summary.text: Neil Walter is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 74 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Walter is an educator and former business executive.

paragraphs.text: Neil Walter was born in Utah and lives there.
He graduated from Dixie High School, earned a B.S. in finance from Brigham Young University in 1999, and earned an M.B.A. from Carnegie Mellon University in 2003.
His career experience includes working as a quantitative analyst with ConocoPhillips, a finance and economics teacher at Dixie State University, and CEO of ERA Brokers and NAI Excel.
Walter took office in 2023, succeeding V. Lowry Snow in District 74.
